title: Pennsylvania finds Walmart child labour violations; retailer agrees to pay $7.8m after injuries
summary_full: Walmart has reached a settlement in response to a Pennsylvania investigation that uncovered serious breaches of child labour laws. The probe identified instances of young workers facing excessive hours and lacking work permits across various locations. As part of the settlement, Walmart will incur penalties of $7.8 million and must adopt stricter compliance protocols to safeguard young employees, setting a crucial benchmark in tackling child labour issues in the state.
